_readme: First-page renders of Open Access PDFs, by NNN. Written by scripts/build_thumbnails.py. The images live in site/thumbs/, which is GITIGNORED: a page image is derived from a source document and a committed one cannot be taken back without rewriting history, so they reach a host through the deploy rather than through a commit. Copy site/thumbs/ alongside site/ when publishing. A record absent from here is not an error: the page draws a tile from its kind and year instead.
